title: Incident (content/incidents/<id>.json)
$comment: GDD 'Incident schema', CLAUDE.md 'Content and fact accuracy', ADR-0009 and ADR-0023. Cross-references between orders, the solution and fact ids are checked in tools/validate_content.py. No campaign field (ADR-0009).

id.$comment: Must equal the file name without .json.

colony_type.$comment: The colony types in the GDD's 'Setting and fiction' table.

task_statement.$comment: The exam guide's task statement number, such as 1.4. Its leading digit must match the domain.
task_statement.description: must be a task statement number such as 1.4

orders.$comment: Every order on the table. Each is either in the solution or a wrong order, never both and never neither.

solution.$comment: Exactly one solution, recorded as one list of order ids: one order, or one set of orders needed together (ADR-0023).

wrong_orders.$comment: Three or four tempting wrong orders, each tagged with its doctrine and its delayed consequence.

delay_ticks.$comment: Ticks between the order and the damage surfacing (ADR-0020: one tick is one simulated minute, values are integers within 2^40). At least one tick, because the consequence is delayed.

items.description: must be a fact id: lowercase dotted segments such as hooks.pretooluse.deny

exam_rewrite.$comment: The scenario in exam phrasing for the after-action report. The report's answer options are taken from the orders (ADR-0023), so they are not repeated here.

slug.description: must be lowercase words joined by hyphens

text.description: must be non-empty text without leading or trailing whitespace
